pressure mounts: As the final exam gets closer, the pressure mounts and many students find it hard to sleep at night.
隨著期末考逼近，壓力升高，許多學生晚上很難入睡。
mount a campaign: The students decided to mount a campaign to stop the school from cutting down the old trees.
學生們決定發起活動，阻止學校砍掉那些老樹。
mount an attack: The army waited until midnight to mount an attack on the enemy camp across the river.
軍隊等到半夜才對河對岸的敵營發動攻擊。
mount the stage: When her name was called, the shy girl took a deep breath and began to mount the stage to receive her prize.
她的名字被叫到時，那位害羞的女孩深吸一口氣，開始登上舞台領獎。
mount a horse: The farmer showed the children how to mount a horse safely by putting one foot in the stirrup first.
農夫示範給孩子們看如何安全地上馬：先把一隻腳踩進馬鐙。
mounting debts: After losing his job, the man could not pay his mounting debts and had to sell his car.
失業之後，那名男子無法償還累積的債務，只好賣掉他的車。
mount a challenge: The young tennis player hopes to mount a challenge to the world champion at next month's tournament.
那位年輕網球選手希望在下個月的錦標賽向世界冠軍發起挑戰。
mourn the dead: Every year on this day, people light candles in the square to mourn the dead of the terrible earthquake.
每年的這一天，人們都會在廣場點蠟燭，哀悼那場可怕地震的死者。
mourn the loss of: The whole village came together to mourn the loss of the kind doctor who had cared for them for forty years.
全村的人聚在一起，為失去那位照顧他們四十年的好心醫生而哀悼。
mourn the passing of an era: When the old movie theater finally closed, many older people in town mourned the passing of an era with tears.
那間老電影院終於關門時，鎮上許多年長的人含淚哀悼一個時代的終結。
move house: We have to move house next month because my father got a new job in another city.
我們下個月得搬家，因為我爸爸在另一個城市找到新工作。
be moved to tears: Many people in the audience were moved to tears when the boy sang a song for his sick mother.
當那個男孩為生病的母親唱歌時，觀眾中許多人都感動落淚。
move on: Breaking up with her boyfriend was painful, but she knew it was time to move on and start a new life.
和男友分手很痛苦，但她知道是時候往前走、展開新生活了。
make a move: If you really like her, you should make a move and ask her out before someone else does.
如果你真的喜歡她，就該採取行動，在別人之前約她出去。
move the audience: The speaker's true story about growing up poor was able to move the audience deeply.
那位講者關於貧困成長的真實故事深深打動了觀眾。
move a motion: At the student council meeting, Amy stood up to move a motion that the school should allow phones at lunch.
在學生會議上，艾美起身提出動議，主張學校應允許午餐時間使用手機。
move in circles: As a famous lawyer, she moves in circles where everyone seems to know the mayor personally.
身為知名律師，她在一個似乎人人都認識市長本人的圈子裡活動。
problems multiplied: After the company grew too fast, its problems multiplied, and the boss could not solve them all.
公司成長太快之後，問題倍增，老闆無法全部解決。
multiply one's chances: Learning a second language can multiply your chances of finding a good job after college.
學第二外語可以增加你大學畢業後找到好工作的機會。
rabbits multiply: Farmers on the island worry because rabbits multiply very quickly and eat all the young plants.
島上的農夫很擔心，因為兔子繁殖得非常快，會吃光所有幼苗。
multiply 3 by 4: To find the area of the small box, you simply multiply 3 by 4 and get twelve square meters.
要算出那個小方框的面積，你只要三乘以四，得到十二平方公尺。
the city mushroomed: After the new factories opened, the city mushroomed, and farmland turned into tall buildings in just ten years.
新工廠開設後，城市迅速擴張，農地在短短十年內變成了高樓。
mushroom overnight: When bubble tea became popular, new drink shops seemed to mushroom overnight on every street.
珍珠奶茶流行起來時，新的飲料店似乎一夜之間就在每條街上冒出來。
costs mushroomed: The bridge was supposed to be cheap, but costs mushroomed when the workers found problems underground.
那座橋原本應該很便宜，但工人發現地底下的問題後，費用暴增。
muster courage: It took the shy boy a whole week to muster courage and tell the teacher the truth.
那個害羞的男孩花了整整一週才鼓起勇氣，向老師說出實話。
muster support: The mayor tried to muster support for the new park by visiting every neighborhood in the city.
市長拜訪市內每個社區，試圖為新公園集結支持。
muster the strength: After running for three hours, the tired runner could barely muster the strength to cross the finish line.
跑了三個小時後，那位疲累的跑者幾乎鼓不起力氣跨越終點線。
pass muster: Her first report did not pass muster, so the manager asked her to rewrite it with more details.
她的第一份報告不合格，所以經理要她加入更多細節重寫。
